title: How to Live Like the Prophet ﷺ - Session 6

clips.title: You Were Sent to Bring Ease, Not Hardship
clips.hook: So a nomad, a desert nomad, entered into the mosque of the Prophet ﷺ. And he urinated in the mosque
clips.overlay: A man urinated in the Prophet's ﷺ mosque — and his response was: 'Leave him.'
clips.caption: A man urinated in the Prophet's ﷺ mosque. His response changed everything.

clips.title: She Came to the Masjid Drunk
clips.hook: When I was an imam in Boston, a young woman came into my office drunk, inebriated.
clips.overlay: A drunk woman walked into my masjid asking for help. Here's what we did.
clips.caption: She walked into the masjid drunk. Allah sent her there.

clips.title: The Prophet ﷺ Shortened Prayer for a Crying Baby
clips.hook: I stand for prayer, I want to lengthen my prayer, and I hear the crying of the child
clips.overlay: The Prophet ﷺ shortened his prayer because a baby was crying — for the mother's sake.
clips.caption: He ﷺ didn't just think about the crying baby — he thought about the mother's heart.

clips.title: The Best Marriage Is the Easiest One
clips.hook: The Prophet ﷺ says خير النكاح أيسره — the best of marriage is that which is done with ease
clips.overlay: The best marriages are the easiest ones. Stop making dowry a barrier to entry.
clips.caption: The Prophet ﷺ said the best marriages are the easiest ones.

clips.title: Don't Die Without the Best Opinion of Allah
clips.hook: None of you should pass until you have the best opinion of God
clips.overlay: 'I have sins.' 'Wallahi, He is Ghafoor Rahim — He is so kind.'
clips.caption: She was dying and said, 'I have so many sins.' This is what I told her.

clips.title: Hellfire Is Denied the Easygoing Person
clips.hook: Shall I not inform you of whom is denied the fire, or of whom the fire is denied?
clips.overlay: Hellfire is DENIED to every approachable, amicable, easygoing person.
clips.arabic: تُحْرَمُ النَّارُ عَلَى كُلِّ هَيِّنٍ لَيِّنٍ سَهْلٍ
clips.caption: Want to know who the Hellfire is DENIED? The Prophet ﷺ told us.

clips.title: Don't Be a Semi-Truck to New Muslims
clips.hook: People who have no idea about religion are just coming into the scope of Islam — and then they're met with a semi-truck
clips.overlay: New Muslims are being met with 18-wheeler semi-trucks of haram lists. They need mercy, not a crash.
clips.caption: Stop ramming new Muslims with 18-wheeler semi-trucks of haram lists.

clips.title: The Prophet's Most Common Phrase During Hajj
clips.hook: Do you know what the most common thing that the Prophet ﷺ said in that hajj was?
clips.overlay: The #1 thing the Prophet ﷺ said during Hajj: 'Do it — and don't worry.'
clips.caption: The most common thing on his tongue: افعل ولا حرج — 'Do it, and don't worry.'

clips.title: Allah Wants Ease for You
clips.hook: When Allah ﷻ says in the Quran يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ الْعُسْرَ
clips.overlay: Don't EVER conceive of religion in the language of hardship. Allah wants ease for you.
clips.arabic: يُرِيدُ اللَّهُ بِكُمُ الْيُسْرَ وَلَا يُرِيدُ بِكُمُ الْعُسْرَ
clips.caption: Allah literally told you: 'I want EASE for you.'

clips.title: Your Identity as a Muslim Is to Be a Bringer of Ease
clips.hook: Your identity when you think of yourself as a believer is أنت مُيَسِّر. You bring ease.
clips.overlay: Your identity as a believer: مُيَسِّر — You bring EASE. Check your attitude before you check others.
clips.caption: مُيَسِّر — 'Bringer of ease.' That's your IDENTITY as a believer.
